description: Prebuilt IRS/FTB reference corpus, tax year 2025: 35 documents (28 sets of form instructions, 7 IRS publications), 5,470 passages, FTS5 + embeddinggemma-2 768-dim embeddings, Haiku contextual summaries, and each document's source PDF (ref_document_files).
_notes: GitHub Release asset (corpus-v3 tag). Embeddings are EmbeddingGemma 2 (ollama/embeddinggemma-2, stamped in ref_meta), so clones running Ollama need no reembed. The PDFs live in the database, not in git; packages/sources keeps their sidecars. Everyone downloads the full corpus; per-state packs are a future option if size demands it.
